messages:
alex: Heads-up: we just saw a spike in admission rejects on us-west dedicated-reserved pool starting ~1964202400. Tenant cold-start batch jobs flooded nodes after deploy — lots of 429s and 'no available slots'. Investigating.

maria: ACK. seeing queue growth on the metrics dash. Is it the new onboarding job? Correlates with rollout window.

sam: Yep, the new onboarding workflow launches parallel GPU init for ~20 tenants. We underestimated startup concurrency. Quick mitigations: reduce concurrency, or throttle per-tenant ramp.

liz: Oncall here, running triage now. Pulling scheduler logs. snippet: ```kubectl logs gpu-scheduler-0 -n infra | tail -n 50
E0123 10:04:12 admission.go:87] admit: pool reserved-usw2-1 saturated, queue_len=312
WARN: eviction pressure threshold breached
```

alex: Can we carve a small capacity window for onboarding (reserve 2 GPUs) and limit parallel init to 4 per-tenant? Also re-route low-priority tenants to burst pool while we clear backlog.

maria: I'm prepping a hotfix for the admission controller to honor onboarding-tier=handshake limit=4. Will push a canary in ~2m. @sam can you throttle the orchestration? :thumbsup:

autoscaler-bot: Scaled up reserved-usw2-2 by +2 nodes (policy=short-burst) — current nodes: 18 -> 20.

sam: Done — paused the orchestration concurrency at the source and added a 10s jitter between tenant inits. Also noticed: weight allocator change from last deploy seems to ignore per-tenant minimums when pool is saturated — that amplified the problem.

liz: Took actions: paused onboarding workflows, evicted 12 queued sessions (low-priority), rebalanced fairshare weights. Watching rejection rate now.

alex: Nice work. If rates drop, let's keep the canary for 30m then roll the admission fix cluster-wide. Afterwards we should run a short postmortem and add an integration test for onboarding concurrency. @maria can you file?

maria: Filed INF-7898: "onboarding cold-start concurrency -> admission controls + tests". Adding notes about weight-allocator regression and short-burst autoscale gaps. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Incident note created: "cold-start onboarding surge caused reserved pool saturation; temporary throttles and +2 node short-burst applied."

alex: Leaving this thread open until metrics stable for 30m. Thanks team.
